## Types and connection rules

Zero-based group indices; real unbalanced one-factor calculation. No padding with invented zero observations.

- Type resolution: `custom_resolver`; result expression: `resolve:frog.studio.statistics.type-resolution@1`.

Port order: `x` → `index_a` → `levels_a`.
